title: Home screen loads
steps: Launch the app and wait for the home screen; inspect primary text, buttons, images and visible loading states.
expected: Home content renders without crash, clipped critical content, indefinite spinner or obvious broken asset.

title: Primary navigation is understandable
steps: Review labels and tap the primary navigation controls available from Home.
expected: Navigation labels are understandable and each enabled control opens the expected destination.

title: Start flow can be entered
steps: From Home, tap the control that begins the application flow.
expected: The first application step opens and clearly communicates what information/action is required.

title: Back and forward navigation preserves state
steps: Enter non-sensitive sample input where permitted; move forward one step and return.
expected: Navigation works without crash and previously entered state behaves consistently with the product design.

title: FAQ page opens and content is readable
steps: Open FAQs/Help; expand or open at least two help items.
expected: Help content loads, text is readable, and expand/collapse or links respond correctly.

title: Help links are valid
steps: Tap each visible help link that is safe to open and return to the app.
expected: Links open the intended destination without 404/error and returning to the app is possible.

title: Support section opens
steps: Open the support/contact section and inspect all visible channels.
expected: Support options are visible, understandable and not obviously incomplete or broken.

title: Contact action resolves correctly
steps: Tap one non-destructive contact action such as email, web form or phone intent without sending a message.
expected: The correct external handler or in-app contact form opens with sensible destination details.

title: No obvious responsiveness blocker
steps: Navigate Home → Start → Help → Support while observing input response and loading.
expected: No repeatable freeze, crash, severe visual jank or loading delay that blocks the short test flow.
